privacy: Stores normalized status only. API keys, certificate fingerprints, account identities, OAuth values, tokens, UIDs, and raw credential payloads are prohibited.
usageRule: Future Codex runs must reuse PASS and NOT_APPLICABLE results below and must not repeat the console check unless a listed reverify trigger occurs. FAIL items remain release blockers until their fix ticket records direct correction evidence.

requirements.productionRequirement: Firebase Authentication App Check enforcement must be aligned with the Google-only Android runtime.
requirements.authoritativeSource: Firebase Console App Check API enforcement state and current Google-only runtime composition
requirements.evidenceLocation: Firebase Console > App Check > APIs > Authentication; apps/mobile/lib/main.dart
requirements.automatedCheck: Google-only runtime composition proves App Check activation is disabled for this lane.
requirements.runtimeCheck: Not required while Authentication remains Unenforced.
reverifyWhen: Firebase Authentication App Check enforcement changes
Google-only runtime App Check activation changes

requirements.productionRequirement: Identity Toolkit API must be enabled in the Firebase project receiving the credential exchange.
requirements.evidenceLocation: Google Cloud Console > APIs and services > Identity Toolkit API
requirements.automatedCheck: None without authenticated Cloud read access.
requirements.runtimeCheck: Firebase credential exchange remains the acceptance boundary.
reverifyWhen: Identity Toolkit API service state changes

requirements.productionRequirement: The Firebase Android API key must allow Identity Toolkit API.
requirements.evidenceLocation: Google Cloud Console > APIs and services > Credentials > Firebase Android key
requirements.automatedCheck: Read-only page inspection returns only the normalized allowlist result.
requirements.externalConsoleCheck: Identity Toolkit API is included in the restricted API allowlist.
requirements.runtimeCheck: Firebase credential exchange remains the acceptance boundary.

requirements.productionRequirement: The Firebase Android API key must allow the exact installed application package.
requirements.authoritativeSource: Google Cloud Android application restrictions and installed APK identity
requirements.evidenceLocation: Google Cloud Console > Firebase Android key > Android restrictions; verified release APK
requirements.automatedCheck: Read-only page inspection confirms only exact package presence.

requirements.productionRequirement: The Firebase Android API key must allow the exact signing certificate of the installed release APK.
requirements.authoritativeSource: Google Cloud Android application restrictions and verified APK signature
requirements.evidenceLocation: Non-emitting comparison of the Firebase Android key restriction rows with the r60.86 APK signer
requirements.automatedCheck: Comparison emits MATCHED or MISSING only and clears the transient certificate value.
requirements.externalConsoleCheck: Current r60.86 signer is present after the authorized single-row correction and independent reload verification.
requirements.runtimeCheck: r60.86 reaches FirebaseAuth.signInWithCredential and is rejected.
reverifyWhen: The FIX14 restriction correction is saved
A new diagnostic or final APK is signed

requirements.productionRequirement: Identity Platform blocking functions must not reject the Google creation/sign-in path.
requirements.evidenceLocation: Firebase Console > Authentication > Settings > Blocking functions
requirements.automatedCheck: None without authenticated console read access.
requirements.externalConsoleCheck: Before-account-creation and before-sign-in hooks are both unconfigured.
reverifyWhen: Either Identity Platform blocking hook is configured

requirements.productionRequirement: Identity Platform user actions must permit Google account creation/sign-in.
requirements.evidenceLocation: Firebase Console > Authentication > Settings > User actions
requirements.automatedCheck: None without authenticated console read access.
requirements.runtimeCheck: Firebase may create or authenticate the Google user.

requirements.productionRequirement: The Google sign-in exchange must target the configured Identity Platform tenant or the default project when multi-tenancy is disabled.
requirements.authoritativeSource: Google Cloud Identity Platform tenant settings
requirements.evidenceLocation: Google Cloud Console > Identity Platform > Tenants
requirements.automatedCheck: None without authenticated console read access.
requirements.runtimeCheck: Default-project FirebaseAuth exchange applies; no tenant identifier is required.
reverifyWhen: Runtime Firebase tenant assignment is introduced

nextAction: Stop Google repair work. Run the locked r60.87 baseline checker before any future Google-authentication change, reuse stable PASS and NOT_APPLICABLE evidence, and do not touch another provider until the founder explicitly authorizes it.
